terbaru.judul: Generating Input Distributions for Explaining Portfolio Optimization Pipelines
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a predict-optimize-explain framework that uses gradient-based sample generation to interpret various portfolio models by identifying macroeconomic conditions that induce specified portfolio outcomes.

terbaru.judul: A Two-Stage Decision Support System for Sustainability-Aware Long Short Portfolio Optimization
terbaru.pelajaran: To solve it, we introduce an adaptive particle swarm solver equipped with a controller that selects, at each iteration, the most suitable recombination operator from a diverse pool of operators and combines it with a projection-based repair mechanism for constraint management.

terbaru.judul: Convergence of the Safeguarded Augmented Lagrangian Method under the Polyak-Lojasiewicz constraint qualification for Constrained Composite Optimization
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work we provide theoretical and practical results of the Safeguarded Augmented Lagrangian Method (SALM) for constrained composite optimization problems whose objective is the sum of a smooth and a nonsmooth function.

terbaru.judul: Asymmetry PRISM: A CPU/GPU Portfolio Optimization Engine for Deadline-Bounded Institutional Rebalancing
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper evaluates Asymmetry PRISM, a CPU/GPU portfolio optimization engine, through a public evaluation boundary; problem data in, and returned weights, status codes, timings, memory class, external feasibility diagnostics, eligible objective comparisons, and audit records out.

terbaru.judul: Robust Bayesian Portfolio Optimization with Discrepancy-based Posterior Ambiguity
terbaru.pelajaran: We study a continuous-time robust Bayesian portfolio optimization problem under drift uncertainty of risky assets.

terbaru.judul: The Mathematics of Heuristic Portfolio Optimization (HPO)
terbaru.pelajaran: For RA-HRP, we introduce fixed-tree cluster-Sharpe recursion, unit-free HRP--RA-HRP interpolation, tangency conditions, conditional-risk splits, and pathwise/KL decompositions of weight distortion.

terbaru.judul: Exponential Adaptive Smoothing and Importance Sampling for Optimization of the Conditional Value-at-Risk
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a novel method for solving conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) optimization problems based on the dual representation of CVaR, which is defined as the worst-case expectation over a risk envelope.

terbaru.judul: VQA for Dynamic Portfolio Optimization: Sampling Strategies, Optimizer Scheduling, and Hardware-Aware Ansatz Design
terbaru.pelajaran: We study these factors for dynamic portfolio optimization, a multi-period financial problem balancing return, risk, transaction costs, cash-interest effects, and constraints.

terbaru.judul: Scaling Decision-Focused Learning to Large Problems with Lagrangian Decomposition
